name: ModelVariant839_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant839_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (the ambient light dims while sixteen animated sparks spray from a model part and, every other frame, another of up to 128 bubbles leaves it, drifting forward and slowly sinking; once a bubble passes the far depth it bursts into a six-frame flash and four fragments that drift apart, and once the last bubble has burst after spawning ends the light comes back); for a non-negative request it selects the config record indexed by the request, seeds the bubbles, fragments and sparks and packs three texture images, otherwise it runs one frame and returns 0 before the start time, 4 on each frame after the first bubble bursts, 1 once when the last bubble has burst after spawning ends, 2 once the light has recovered and 0 otherwise; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; the French header-856 and 953 images build it from the same source. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
